description.value:
DV 10

At the start of the target's next Turn, they are compelled to take a Move Action chosen by the Netrunner to investigate a phantom noise.

Lure only works if the target is unaware a Netrunner has Jacked In.

The target is not alerted to the QuickHack.

Cannot force movement into obvious physical danger.
